artifacts.content: I just finished the weekly performance audit for the fraud detection service. The model accuracy metrics have remained static for the past two weeks. We are currently running the same inference weights that were pushed to production in March. The monitoring dashboard shows no automated alerts firing because the retraining trigger mechanism is not configured in the pipeline. My team manually checks the drift logs every Friday morning to see if the input distribution has shifted. If we spot a significant variance, we open a ticket for the data science team to rebuild the model. Until then, the system continues serving predictions based on the stale artifacts without any automatic intervention or scheduled refresh cycles.

wrong_descriptions.driver: Someone on the team wants the retraining trigger to be fully automated.
wrong_descriptions.boundary: The team will not accept a retraining process without a trigger.
wrong_descriptions.trade_off: The team would accept a manual retraining process if the trigger is not critical.
